I sat down with Raema from Gifty Gal and we talked about how she built a six-figure corporate gifting business while working about 20 hours a week as a stay-at-home mom of four. We got into how personalized gifting helps sales teams open doors, get replies, and stand out way more than generic prospecting gifts. She broke down her margins, how she sources products wholesale, why LinkedIn has been her best growth channel, and the four-part framework she uses to run the business: connect, collaborate, curate, and fulfill. We also talked about startup costs, how she grew from packing gifts at home to using a shared warehouse, and why this is a surprisingly approachable business to start.
